text.card: A red giant 6,801 parsecs away, 23 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 1.37 solar masses and 23.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,747 K at its surface.
